items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s the one with Idris, from Prestige.

ctx.x: Yes, and the others were my jazz pals coming in. That’s the one with Idris, from Prestige.
But all during this period of building, your scenario was running over here to see what was going on and running your optometry business and then recording.
